svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.29.3.2 Fastening
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.29 INTERIOR WALL AND CEILING FINISHES

g.text: Drawn 4 times actual, nail diameter schematic

svg.text: Furring is fastened to the framing or to wood
blocks with not less than 51 mm (2″) nails.
The Article sets the nail length only. Nail diameter, block sizes and block layout are schematic.
